officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official law defines cadastral maps as graphical/textual land-cadastre records and says they depict parcel boundaries, areas, turning-point coordinates and cadastral numbers. Typical cadastral maps cover Ashgabat. It also provides that cadastral information is furnished under an established procedure, may be paid, and may be subject to access restrictions.
